## Objective
Define the production formula for one system-matrix element $h_{ij}$ and map every term to the current raytracing implementation.

## Master Formula
For detector voxel $i$ and source voxel $j$, define

$$
\begin{aligned}
h_{ij}
&= P_{\mathrm{att},ij}\, P_{\mathrm{abs},ij}\, G_{ij} \\
P_{\mathrm{att},ij}
&= \exp\!\left(-\sum_{k=1}^{K} \mu_k\,L_{k,ij}\right) \\
P_{\mathrm{abs},ij}
&= 1 - \exp\!\left(-\mu_{\mathrm{crystal}}\,L_{\mathrm{crystal},ij}\right) \\
G_{ij}
&= \frac{\Omega_{ij}}{4\pi}.
\end{aligned}
$$

## Term-to-Code Mapping

- $\mu_k$: user/material table input (external mapping by object/material ID).
- $L_{\text{crystal},ij}$: computed from exact detector-voxel surface intersections (12-triangle voxel mesh, backward ray query).
- $\mu_{\mathrm{crystal}}$
